vision.model.loading: Reading the task from the labels
vision.model.task.none: No model can be trained yet
vision.model.leftOut: Left out, fewer than 5 images each: {classes}.
vision.model.nothing: Nothing to train until the rule finds a task.
vision.model.leaks: {count} test images have a near copy in train: the test score will be optimistic (R-VQ-11).
vision.model.trainHint: From seconds to a few minutes; nothing runs until you ask. The descriptors and vectors are computed once per image and kept with the set.
vision.model.advancedHint: another task, the classic models only, the anomaly detector, More models
vision.model.taskHint: Another possible task can be chosen; the rule stays shown at the top.
vision.model.dinoNote: A frozen network turns each image into a vector; a logistic regression and a nearest-neighbour vote classify them. The desktop default when its weights are here (R-VCL-06).
vision.model.detectorAutoNote: PatchCore when its weights are here, otherwise the classic models only (R-VAN-06).
vision.model.detectorNoneNote: Patch PCA, nearest normal images and their average rank: no network, no download, also in the browser.
vision.model.downloadSafety: Fetched once over HTTPS from a fixed revision on Hugging Face, checked against its SHA-256 fingerprint before use. Only the safetensors format is read: no downloaded code ever runs.
vision.results.loadingRun: Reading the run and its predictions
vision.results.emptyBody: Train the models in Model: every metric, the confusion matrix, the threshold and the images the model gets wrong appear here.
vision.results.intervalNote: Intervals: 95 % bootstrap, resampling groups of copies together.
vision.results.perClassSentence: {label} is the class found least often: {recall} of its images.
vision.results.confusionSentence: Rows are the true class, columns what the model said; the diagonal is right. Click a cell to see its images.
vision.results.confusionCaption: Confusion matrix, rows are the true class and columns the predicted class
vision.results.rocSentence: Area under the curve {value}: 0.5 is chance, 1 a perfect ranking.
vision.results.prSentence: Average precision {value}: how precise the model stays as it finds more.
vision.results.noCurve: Not enough images of each kind to draw a curve.
vision.results.legend: Classes and their area under the curve
vision.results.reliabilitySentence: The confidence is {ece} away from the share right on average (ECE), at most {mce} in one bin (MCE). On the diagonal, a model is as right as it says.
vision.results.temperature: Temperature scaling (T = {t}) would bring the ECE to {after}, without changing a single prediction.
vision.results.temperatureApplied: Temperature scaling applied out of fold (R-VM-06): ECE {before} → {after}, log loss {lossBefore} → {lossAfter}. Predictions unchanged; T = {t} for new images.
vision.results.confidentErrorsSentence: Wrong and sure of it: often a wrong label, a near copy of another class, or an unusual picture.
vision.results.uncertainSentence: The images the model hesitates on most, right or wrong.
vision.results.noError: No error on the scored images.
vision.results.tip.accuracy: Share of images given their true class. Misleading when one class is much larger than the others.
vision.results.tip.balanced_accuracy: The mean of the recall of each class: every class counts the same, however many images it has.
vision.results.tip.f1_macro: The mean of the F1 of each class (F1: the balance of precision and recall).
vision.results.tip.kappa: Agreement with the truth beyond what chance would give: 0 is chance, 1 perfect.
vision.results.tip.roc_auc: The chance that an image of a class gets a higher probability for it than an image of another class.
vision.results.tip.pr_auc: Average precision: how precise the model stays as it recalls more of a class.
vision.results.tip.log_loss: How surprised the model is by the truth, on average. Lower is better; punishes confident errors hard.
vision.results.tip.brier: The mean squared gap between the probabilities and the truth. Lower is better.
vision.results.tip.ece: Expected calibration error: the mean gap between the confidence and the share right, over 15 bins. Above 0.05, temperature scaling is proposed.
vision.results.tip.mce: Maximum calibration error: the largest gap in one bin.
vision.results.tip.topk: Share of images whose true class is among the {k} most probable.
vision.results.tip.auroc: The chance that a defect scores higher than a normal image. The main metric of anomaly detection: it does not depend on a threshold.
vision.results.tip.ap: Area under the precision and recall curve of the defects.
vision.results.tip.f1At: The balance of precision and recall at the threshold shown; it follows the threshold you move.
vision.results.tip.pixelAuroc: The same AUROC on every pixel: are defect pixels hotter on the map than normal ones?
vision.results.tip.aupro: How much of each defect region is found before 30 % of normal pixels are flagged, every region counting the same (Bergmann et al. 2021).
vision.results.tip.regions: Connected regions of the masks, each one counted by AUPRO.
vision.results.tip.silhouette: How much closer an image is to its own cluster than to the next one: from -1 to 1, higher is clearer.
vision.results.tip.ari: Agreement of the clusters with the labels, beyond chance: 0 is chance, 1 the same groups.
vision.results.thresholdChart: Scores of the normal images and of the defects, with the threshold; drag the line or use the arrows to move it
vision.results.thresholdSentence: At {value}, {found} of {defects} defects are found and {alarms} of {normals} normal images are flagged by mistake (F1 {f1}).
vision.results.thresholdSentenceNoDefect: At {value}, {flagged} of {count} images are flagged as unusual.
vision.results.histHint: Drag the line, or focus it and use the arrows
vision.results.byTypeSame: Every defect type is told from normal images as well (AUROC {value}).
vision.results.byTypeSentence: {type} is the hardest kind to tell from normal images (AUROC {value}).
vision.results.flaggedSentence: At or above the threshold, most unusual first.
vision.results.missedSentence: Defects below the threshold, the most normal-looking first.
vision.results.alarmsSentence: Normal images at or above the threshold.
vision.results.unusualSentence: Every scored image, from the most to the least unusual.
vision.results.noFlagged: No image at or above the threshold.
vision.results.noMissed: No defect missed at this threshold.
vision.results.noAlarm: No false alarm at this threshold.
vision.results.mapCaveat: The map shows where the model found the image unusual; with PatchCore it is the score itself, patch by patch. It shows where, not why.
vision.results.view.noMap: This model gives a score, not a map.
vision.results.view.mapMissing: No map was kept for this image (at most 1,000 per run).
vision.results.view.mapFrom: The map comes from the patch PCA: the nearest-image score has none.
vision.results.view.legend: transparent: as in the normal images; strong: most unusual in this run
vision.results.view.nearestSentence: The framed area looks least like the normal images; the closest normal patch is the one framed in {name}, at distance {distance}.
vision.results.view.reconstructionSenten: {model} rebuilds the image from what it learnt on normal images; where the rebuild differs is unusual.
vision.results.view.mapCompareSentence: The image and its anomaly map on the theme's scale (light: as in the normal images; dark: most unusual in this run). Slide or toggle between them.
vision.results.view.compareLabel: {name}: the image and what the model makes of it
vision.results.view.noDifference: The map is not a picture of the same scene: no difference to compute.
vision.results.medoids: The most typical image of each cluster
vision.results.medoidsSentence: Each cluster's medoid: the image closest to all the others of its cluster.
